verdict.rationale: Gemini's own help docs say Gemini Apps can personalize responses based on "the memory of your past Gemini chats," which directly covers recalling prior-chat context in new conversations. Notebooks add a continuous chat that remembers sources, instructions and ongoing discussions. Missing for 10: detail on how memory is selected, viewed or managed; explicit documentation that recalled context is applied in brand-new chats beyond the one-line claim; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: You can get a personalized experience in Gemini Apps based on: The memory of your past Gemini chats
Notebooks provide a continuous chat experience that remembers your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions.
